title: Understanding AUC-ROC
text: AUC-ROC is a performance measurement for classification problems at various thresholds settings. It tells how much the model is capable of distinguishing between classes.

title: Effect of Threshold on AUC-ROC
text: Changing the threshold affects the True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR), but AUC-ROC is calculated over all possible thresholds.

title: AUC-ROC Calculation
text: AUC-ROC is the area under the ROC curve, which plots TPR against FPR at various threshold settings. It is not dependent on a single threshold.
